item.title: MEXODUS to Return to NYC This Spring at the Daryl Roth Theatre
item.description: On the heels of a twice-extended run at Audible’s Minetta Lane Theatre in Fall 2025, Mexodus, the new musical written and performed by Brian Quijada and Nygel D. Robinson, choreographed by Tony Thomas, and directed by David Mendizábal, will return to New York City this spring for a limited 10-week-only engagement. item.title: Seattle Children's Theatre Withdraws From Upcoming Kennedy Center Engagement
item.description: Seattle Children’s Theatre has withdrawn from an upcoming two-week run of performances at The John F. Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts in Washington, D.C, reports NPR. BroadwayWorld previously reported the company had been scheduled to bring its new play, Young Dragon: A Bruce Lee Story, to the Kennedy Center for performances in April, following a February 20 premiere in Seattle. item.title: Metropolitan Opera Announces Layoffs, Salary Cuts, and Reduced Programming Amid Ongoing Financial Strain
item.description: The Metropolitan Opera has announced a new round of cost-cutting measures, including layoffs, executive pay reductions, and a scaled-back production schedule, as it continues to grapple with financial instability, according to reporting by the The New York Times. The company said it will eliminate 22 administrative positions and temporarily reduce salaries for its highest-paid executives, with cuts ranging from 4 to 15 percent. item.title: Hochul Proposes to Enhance NYC Musical and Theatrical Production Tax Credit
item.description: As first reported by Broadway Journal, New York Governor Kathy Hochul proposed allocating an additional $150 million to retroactively extend a New York State theater tax credit program. item.title: Rachel Potter, Susan Egan, Caroline Bowman And More To Perform In OFF BROADWAY: AN EVENING OF MAGIC At Hutton Hotel
item.description: Hutton Hotel will host a one-night-only cabaret concert, OFF BROADWAY: AN EVENING OF MAGIC, on January 23 at its Analog performance venue. The event will feature Broadway performers singing selections from classic animated films and will mark the first presentation in the hotel’s new 2026 Off Broadway concert series. item.title: Carolee Carmello, Kecia Lewis and Kate Baldwin To Perform At The New York City Gay Men's Chorus Annual Gala
item.description: New York City Gay Men's Chorus has announced the first slate of performers and honorees for HARMONY, its annual gala benefit, scheduled for Monday, March 23, 2026, at the Edison Ballroom.
